preregistration.expected_outcome:
Does not outperform. On the development seeds flag F1 improved significantly on all four
scenarios (text_timestamp, in the first draft, did not: +0.05, p 0.23, so it was dropped
before registration), but the candidate breached budgets the baseline meets: the false
positive rate rose from 0.01-0.02 to 0.050-0.054 on local, varying_density, contextual
and both swamping variants (a composite fills the review budget, so where it cannot rank
the anomalies it fills it with normal rows), average precision fell on clustered (1.00 to
0.77) and all_categorical, and flag stability fell on local. Confirmation is expected to
show the same trade-off: more anomalies caught where the ranking is good, at the price of
the false-positive budget where it is not.
preregistration.hypothesis:
Thresholding the agreement-weighted composite score at the review budget improves
flag F1 over unanimity on the anomaly types where the ensemble ranking is good but the
unanimous flag under-flags: point, clustered, masking and irrelevant_columns.
